message.content: In the conversation, Fionnuala mentions that the Control Center makes switching between games and apps much smoother, which Ileana appreciates for making her experience more efficient. Specifically, Ileana states, "The Control Center is awesome! I especially love how you can adjust audio settings on the fly without having to pause the game. Makes it so convenient when you're in the heat of action!" This indicates that the Control Center feature allowing for quick adjustments to audio settings is the one that Ileana praises for enhancing her gaming experience.
